clusters.headline: Six Reported Dead Following Shooting Incident In Central Krakow
aiSummaryBullets: At least six individuals were killed and fifteen sustained injuries during a shooting incident in Krakow's main market square.
Reports indicate that the shooter opened fire from a vehicle before being neutralized by police.

clusters.headline: Six People Killed In Shooting Incident At Krakow Main Square
aiSummaryBullets: A gunman wearing military clothing drove into Krakow's main market square and fired randomly at bystanders.
The incident resulted in the deaths of six people and left fifteen to sixteen individuals injured.
